issues.description: Nine `%include` paths are external and absent from the package; some macros are called later and included files must resolve unless author confirms otherwise.
SAS 9.3 is documented but the existing SAS 9.4 startup fails at TKELS; runtime/modules are unverified.
Excel inspection and manual Orbis cleaning, match review, duty, distance and retaliation work are documented but their workbooks/prepared outputs are absent.

SAS exports baseline and summaries, while the datasheet assigns regressions to Stata; no main regression or appendix A1–A15 code is supplied. No analysis-only path is supported by a one-row gvkey probe.

Source creates WORK.PRETRANSPOSE but reads ORBIS.PRETRANSPOSE, writes ORBIS.AFTERTRANSPOSEMORE but reads ORBIS.AFTERTRANSPOSE, and creates ORBIS.UPDATEDCD2 but reads ORBIS.UPDATEDCDl. Confirm intended handoffs before applying exact proposals.

Active ORBIS.DATEBASE, ORBIS.EUID, ORBIS.YEAR and WORK.DICTIONARY reads lack active in-source producers; datebase producer block is commented.

review_notes: Expanded draft saved after complete reading of the README, datasheet, all 1,820 SAS lines, appendix tables, existing probes, exact-name/source-product catalog lookups and bounded official pages. No author code, data downloads, installs or patches were run/applied.
The packaged ids.sas7bdat probe reports one sampled `gvkey`, not a full analysis panel or verified identifier mapping; source renames BvDID to GVKEY. No analysis-only route is supported.

COW v3.0 and current WGI/World Bank case pages are recorded as public candidates with unresolved version/coverage/field compatibility. Worldscope hits are raw catalog discovery candidates only; no field/history/readability probe was performed; capiq is only the code libref.
Exact source edits are proposals only. Full closure remains unresolved pending author-prepared inputs, manual stages, helper files, handoff confirmation and Stata scripts.
